assets.notes: Authored by blender/scripts/author_assets/mannequin.py. 1.75 m, origin on the ground, faces -Y (motion_path rotation_z_deg 90 walks +X). Bone parenting attaches at the bone tail; hand tails are the grip points. mannequin_walk (cycle R1S) travel: 1.075379 m per 32-frame cycle = 0.033606 m/frame (0.807 m/s at 24 fps); with linear root travel at that speed the planted foot is stationary (the toe is the contact point while the heel rises before toe-off). Heels land on cycle frames 9 (left) and 25 (right); cycle frame 17 is left mid-stance, where a walk clip can end and crossfade into mannequin_idle while the root stops, without sliding.
